## Seat review — **ACCEPT**; contract review (clause ②) — **PASS**

PR #7408, head `f6c2f1b`, `Fixes #7360`. Verified on the branch head, not from the PR body:

- Six files, +21/−23, one droppable commit each. The seven funded rows, per row: **re-pointed** `FieldWidgetProps` → `FieldWidgetComponentProps` (plugin-development evals 1 and 3 — the short name matched only as the head of `FieldWidgetPropsSchema`), `sidebar` → `ResponsiveContainer` (mobile eval 1; 0 → 4 in the guide), `section` → `card` (page-builder eval 2; 0 → 4); **dropped** `ComponentRegistry` (project-setup eval 3), `edit` (testing eval 2), `refresh` (page-builder eval 3) — each real elsewhere, none taught by the guide the eval scores, each assertion still grading its decision through the tokens that stay; **taught** `scope.registerComponent(type, component, meta?)` as one bullet in the Namespace system section, paid in the same file (14,335 → 14,325 B, −2 tok) by deleting comments the ComponentMeta table two lines below restates; **left alone, correctly** `useOffline` — the card's premise was wrong there: `packages/react/src/hooks/useOffline.ts:256` is a real export of `@object-ui/react` and `guides/mobile.md` teaches exactly that import, twice.
- **Clause ② at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`** (the served model read via `get_session` equals the constant): the one contract claim the PR adds — that `scope.registerComponent` applies the scope's own name, stores `pluginName:type`, and so takes no `namespace` — is true at source: `packages/types/src/plugin-scope.ts:54` (signature), `packages/core/src/registry/PluginScopeImpl.ts:104-110` (sets `namespace: this.name` on the registry meta) and `:118` (reads `${this.name}:${type}`); `@object-ui/types` `base.ts` declares zero `namespace` keys while core's `Registry.ts:173` declares `namespace?: string`. PASS ⇒ under the 2026-08-31 ruling the same seat strips `needs:contract-review` from this card and from PR #7408.
- Two dispatch premises measured false and both **added** gates rather than removed them (`skill-guide-provider-envelope.test.tsx:248` globs every `must_contain`; `doc-version-claims.test.ts` pins the guide twice, which is why the bullet states no version literal) — accepted. eslint narrowing measured from the config (`.md` / `.json` not in its population).
- CI: every check on `f6c2f1b` green by 18:29Z (Lint, Type Check, Test 4/4 shards, Build & E2E, the doc gates, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Changeset Declaration).

Out of scope, graded by the seat and queued behind this merge (same files): #7405 (p2) and #7406 (p2); the whole-token-vs-substring oracle note is on #7359.

Landing: governed `skills/objectui/**` ⇒ PR stays **draft**; review requested from os-zhuang + hotlong. The base has moved (`behind`); the human merge carries it. At merge the seat strips `pm:dispatched`.
